questions.question: A car travels 150 kilometres in 3 hours and then 200 kilometres in 4 hours. What is the average speed of the car for the entire journey?
Income of Amit in 2019 was ₹25,700. He gets an increment of 10% every year. What was his income (in ₹) in 2021?
The average price of three items of furniture is ₹17,820. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, the price of the cheapest item (in ₹) is:
